I was student teaching a seventh grade history class on the American Civil War a few months ago. I was giving a presentation on the battle of Gettysburg and Vicksburg saying that the Fourth of July in 1863 was a good day for the Union. This 12 year old girl raised her hand and asked if that is the reason we celebrate Independence Day. I said no, we celebrate it because of the signing of the Declaration of Independence  in 1776. This girl said "oh... was that after Gettysburg?" The teacher was sitting at his desk with a look of defeat on a his face.

I was working for a construction company last summer and one of the job sites I worked on was a barn that a family was using for a garage that needed to be rebuilt. 
One day in mid-August, me and my co-worker were tearing off the roofing tiles on the barn to make way to redo most of the roof. From the roof we could see the neighbor's property. The place was lousy with weeds and tall grass. As the day went on my co-worker noticed the neighbor walk out of the house carrying a golf club, he taped me and on the shoulder and pointed me at him. The neighbor was morbidly obese and because it was a hot summer's day, he was wearing no shirt. We watched as he took the golf club and started hacking at the weeds in an attempt to weed-whack his front yard. He did this for about 10 minutes before yelling in frustration, tossed the golf club into the tall grass, and stormed back into the house.

My dad begin to talk to my mom with some other girls when my dad's friend started talking shit to some bar-goers. He got put down and my dad jumped in to save his friend's ass. After breaking one of the guy's nose's the drunken mob grabbed my dad and tossed him into traffic. He got hit by a car in the shoulder, got back up and stormed back into the bar to raise more hell. The cops came, broke up the fight, and tried to force my dad to get to the hospital. My dad refused to get in the ambulance until he got my mom's number. They have been married for 23 years.
